listening.title: First day on the platform team

lines.speaker: Nam (Team Lead)
lines.text: Welcome to the team, Linh. I've prepared a ramp-up plan for your first two weeks.

lines.speaker: Linh (New Developer)
lines.text: Thank you, Nam. Should I start with the local setup today?

lines.speaker: Nam (Team Lead)
lines.text: Yes. Install the tools first, then clone the repository and run the project.

lines.speaker: Linh (New Developer)
lines.text: Do I already have the credentials for the internal systems?

lines.speaker: Nam (Team Lead)
lines.text: IT sent them this morning. Check your email and change the password right away.

lines.speaker: Linh (New Developer)
lines.text: Got it. Who is my point person if something breaks?

lines.speaker: Nam (Team Lead)
lines.text: Minh is your buddy this month. Ask him anything, even small questions.

lines.speaker: Linh (New Developer)
lines.text: Is there a document about the team norms, like meeting times?

lines.speaker: Nam (Team Lead)
lines.text: Yes, our wiki has a short induction page. Please read it before Friday.

lines.speaker: Linh (New Developer)
lines.text: Perfect. I'll finish the knowledge transfer sessions and then take a small ticket.
